target_customer: Post sales and customer success teams at B2B companies (testimonials from Latchel, Lexamica, Rho)
problem: Customer data is scattered across CRM, support, calls and product usage, so post sales teams miss signals about accounts and respond slowly.
business_model: B2B SaaS AI-native customer intelligence platform with agents
product_category: Customer intelligence and customer success platform

founders.name: Pranav Mallampalli
education: UC Berkeley (described as a Cal grad on the YC page, degree not stated)

founders.name: Deepali Jain
education: UC Berkeley, electrical engineering and computer science

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting CRM, call, support and usage data across 40 plus integrations and running agents on top is standard SaaS integration work with some AI difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and customer data history create switching costs, but Gainsight and others added AI features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Gainsight acquired Staircase AI in August 2024 to add AI (per comparison pages). No acquisition of Wavelength found.

market_need_then: Customer success tooling was an established category with incumbents seen as legacy; AI-native replacements were being marketed by 2025 to 2026. Dated demand evidence near 2023 was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: bold, confident and informal with wave imagery and playful words

rebrands.why: Not stated. The site and a LinkedIn repost say Assembly is now Wavelength; date not found. Other companies are also named Assembly.

brand_strength.rationale: A clear rebrand and consistent voice, but no press about the brand and the name is shared with many unrelated Wavelength companies.

outcome_analysis: Wavelength is an active three person company that rebranded from Assembly and sells an AI customer intelligence platform with a few named customers. No funding disclosure, acquisition or shutdown was found. It faces established customer success incumbents that are adding AI, but with no outcome yet no factors are assigned.
notes: No funding information found for this company; other Wavelength companies in search results are unrelated. Rebrand date unknown. The outcome search for Wavelength returned unrelated items. No dated competitor sources near the batch found; the takeover field cites later comparison pages.
